# homeassistant_areas (Data Source)

Lists every area (`config/area_registry/list`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "homeassistant_areas" "all" {}

# Area IDs by name.
output "area_ids" {
  value = { for a in data.homeassistant_areas.all.areas : a.name => a.area_id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `areas` (Attributes List) The areas, sorted by `area_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--areas))

<a id="nestedatt--areas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `areas`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (Set of String) Other names voice assistants accept for the area.
- `area_id` (String) Area ID.
- `floor_id` (String) ID of the floor the area is on; null if it is on none.
- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:sofa`; null if it has none.
- `labels` (Set of String) IDs of the area's labels.
- `name` (String) Name.
